name: Halo: Doom Evolved
summary: Halo Doom Evolved is a TC-lite weapon mod project that aims to bring Halo's classic sandbox themed gameplay, while doubling down on the more retro aspects of it's design. Boasting over 54 weapons, 3 spartan classes with their own unique gameplay styles, 6 different spawning presets based on the different halo games, and many more settings to make the ultimate custom halo experience. Halo: Doom Evolved is compatible with most addon mods, further allowing you to customize your experience. It's able to run most monster mods with little to no issues.
